decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a high-quality, new portable Bluetooth speaker suitable for outdoor gatherings. While the JBL Charge 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) is a great model, this specific listing is for a 'Renewed' unit, and for electronics with lithium batteries, I prefer to buy new to ensure maximum battery longevity. The Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) is a decent budget alternative, but lacks the brand reputation I trust for audio fidelity. The Sony (prod_bluetooth_speakers_144) is impressive but designed for stationary home use rather than portability. The JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) is too small for my intended use case. Finding no new, mid-range portable speakers from top brands in this feed that met my criteria, I decided not to make a purchase.
